from datetime import datetime

from .clock import ensure_utc


def payments_between(payments, start, end):
    """Payments created in [start, end), oldest first."""
    start = ensure_utc(start)
    end = ensure_utc(end)
    selected = [
        payment
        for payment in payments
        if payment.created_at is not None
        and start <= ensure_utc(payment.created_at) < end
    ]
    return sorted(selected, key=lambda payment: ensure_utc(payment.created_at))
